plain_findings: Training the deployment speed contract at speed_rate 0.7 is materially different from post-hoc scaling of a speed_rate 1.0 policy.
Matched P060 pedestrian-speed alignment improves all four fixed cells, so speed distribution mismatch was a contributor.
B3 P060 0S1D passes at CR 7.09%, while P060 1S1D fails at CR 14.10% with a 95% Wilson interval of 12.65-15.68%.
The remaining gap is concentrated in the static-left stratum, but the current layout key is not an exact full-scene mirror and cannot yet establish an intrinsic policy left-right bias.
In B3 P060 1S1D, 272 of 288 non-exclusive scheduler slot-contact events are dynamic-pedestrian events; this is not an episode fraction.
P060 1S1D is nominally about 1% of all resets, but the failed lateral P060 1S1D gate family is only about 0.3%: approximately 182-183 resets, with profile-family active-step exposure unrecorded.
current_problem_statement: The deployment-speed contract and slow-pedestrian mismatch are partly addressed. The unresolved problem is low-exposure P060 1S1D geometry-pedestrian interaction, with a static-side-stratified gap whose causal left-right meaning remains unverified.
required_before_any_future_continuation: profile-level reset, active-step and outcome accounting
dynamic start-direction and patrol-phase metadata by static layout
intermediate checkpoint fixed screens under the same frozen gate
